en: I've been waiting for you! What's the matter? Curious about what's behind me?
Those aren't rocks at all. They're Crustle, carrying their boulders on their backs. Now, observe.
This machine of mine was made to draw out a Pokémon's energy. Let's see what it does for them!
Those Crustle... Were they lying here all along, too worn out to move, boulders and all?
Team Plasma once said that to bring out the potential of Pokémon, people must let them go free. I disagree.
Science is what will draw out their power. That is what I believe, and why I study.
Come to think of it, I never asked your name. ...{player}. I'll remember it.
Now, let me see whether you're a Trainer who can draw out a Pokémon's hidden strength!
I see! Like the Gym Leaders, or the Elite Four and the Champion of the Pokémon League, you bring out your Pokémon's strength by battling at their side.
Please, take this. Consider it my thanks for the data!
How frustrating! If only we could talk with Pokémon, drawing out their power might be simple. But that's hardly science, is it?
A row of boulders blocks the road. Strength won't shift them... Are they breathing?
These boulders just turned up all in a line one morning. Strength won't shift them an inch!
Crustle, all along! If you want to see more of them, they live out in the desert to the north.
